name: Golo
title: Archer, Hunter & Artifact Bearer
subtitle: Half-Giant / Half-Centaur Archer
summary: A powerful centaur archer and hunter whose dwarven alliances grant him rune magic, the magically lightweight Hammer of Earthshatter, and responsibility for a major artifact.
details: Half-Giant / Half-Centaur archer, hunter, and artifact bearer.

powers.name: Master Archer
powers.description: Uses strength, range, and practiced accuracy to strike targets with bows and magical arrows.

powers.name: Ice Arrows
powers.description: Fires magically empowered ice arrows that can damage, freeze, slow, or counter heat and fire.

powers.name: Licensed Fire Rune
powers.description: Uses dwarven-licensed fire rune power under the terms of his employment contract.

powers.name: Hammer of Earthshatter
powers.description: Instantly explodes or powders a 10-foot radius of non-living stone, including non-living spirit-conjured rock.

powers.name: Magically Lightweight Hammer
powers.description: The hammer is easy to wield regardless of normal weight and can be lent to other characters for use.

relationships: Trusted by the dwarves as artifact bearer and rune licensee. Butcher's Guild bond established through the Iceman connection.
specialRules: Earthshatter affects non-living stone and rock conjurations, but does not directly destroy living creatures. The hammer is magically lightweight and may be wielded by anyone Golo lends it to.
